bad_case_001.description: Wall Hollow + Collision / Dead Space Fragmentation
notes: Legacy solver leaves 496 cartons of SKU-14 unplaced due to rigid column slicing and tail-assembly fragmentation.
Visual artifacts show dead space and wall hollows in tail sections.
V2 Acceptance requires overlap_pair_count == 0, penetration_volume == 0, and enclosed cavity detection/mitigation.
